# Citizenship Italia

> Citizenship Italia is an Italian citizenship by descent firm serving Americans, with offices in Toronto and its legal team based in Turin, Italy. We offer end-to-end services for consulate applications, court (ATQ) cases, and 1948 maternal line cases. Licensed Italian legal representation included.

## Core Services

- [How It Works](https://citizenshipitalia.com/process) — 6-step end-to-end process for Italian citizenship by descent (Jure Sanguinis)
- [Check Eligibility](https://citizenshipitalia.com/check-eligibility) — Free 2-minute eligibility quiz for Italian citizenship by descent
- [Pricing](https://citizenshipitalia.com/pricing) — Service packages for consulate, court (ATQ), and 1948 routes
- [Our Team](https://citizenshipitalia.com/our-team) — Licensed Italian lawyers and citizenship specialists

## Application Routes

- [Against the Queue (ATQ) Court Route](https://citizenshipitalia.com/routes/court-atq/) — When a court action (azione di accertamento) may be appropriate, how it works, and its risks
- [1948 Maternal Line Cases](https://citizenshipitalia.com/routes/1948-cases/) — Court route for citizenship transmitted through a female ancestor before 1948
- [Citizenship Through Your Mother or a Female Ancestor](https://citizenshipitalia.com/resources/italian-citizenship-through-mother/) — When a female line works, consulate vs court, and the 2025 rules

## About

Citizenship Italia helps Americans of Italian descent reclaim their Italian (EU) citizenship. We provide end-to-end services including lineage verification, document procurement, certified translation, apostille processing, and licensed Italian legal representation for all three application routes: consulate, ATQ court, and 1948 cases. Court cases are filed with the competent Italian court, generally the one for the area where the Italian ancestor was born.

For comprehensive documentation, see: https://citizenshipitalia.com/llms-full.txt
